fields.description: Mercedes-Benz Places Binghatti City is a masterplanned, multi-tower residential district in the Meydan area of Dubai. It is a separate development from the earlier Downtown Mercedes-Benz tower. Apartments and selected duplex homes are organised around a central park and shared leisure spaces.

overview: The developer describes 12 towers and a central park with 12 experiences. Current plans identify Project Maybach, Ultimate Luxury, Maybach 6 and the separate Vision Iconic tower; different towers have different layouts.
research.locationNote: The developer hero says Nad Al Sheba; its FAQ and Mercedes-Benz’s 16 December 2025 release describe the Meydan area. This is not the separate Downtown tower or Nad Al Sheba Gardens community.
research.priceLabel: Developer advertised from-guide · selected tower to confirm
research.priceNote: The own developer hero advertises AED 1,599,999. Property Finder’s City page gives AED 1.25m in its body and rounds to AED 1.3m. Confirm the named tower, release and current unit quote.
research.paymentNote: The developer FAQ gives 20% down payment, 50% construction and 30% completion. Property Finder instead lists 40/60. No dated unit contract confirms which offer applies; a community guide is not a universal tower schedule.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder forecasts January 2028 for its City entry. The primary material reviewed does not establish a single completion date for all 12 towers. A tower-specific contractual date is required; headline remains unset.

facts.label: Certification target
facts.value: The brochure says the development aims for LEED qualification; achieved certification is not established.

unresolved: Confirm selected tower, release, current price/availability, contractual date, instalment calendar, tenure, approved service charges and parking. Portal leasehold wording is not independently confirmed by primary title documents.
Published totals include outdoor areas. Some plan cells show a square-metre glyph in the SQ.FT column; column headings and numerical correspondence are retained, not treated as a second metric area.

Masterplan amenities and selected private-pool layouts are not identical entitlements for every tower. Services may have separate fees. Do not apply Downtown Mercedes-Benz Places details here. Images remain illustrative.
